description: GitHub Copilot CLI as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-copilot, invoked with --permissions bypass, which for copilot is --allow-all: tools, paths and URLs. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account. An organisation policy can veto this stance: on a seat whose managed settings set bypassDisabled, --allow-all is refused by copilot itself.
